result.question: N-PMI heat resistant ABS compound formulation factors: flame retardants, glass fiber, mineral fillers, compatibilizers, impact modifiers for automotive interior. What additional ingredients beyond the base N-PMI/g-ABS/SAN system can improve HDT, impact strength, VOC, or processability? Include quantitative effects on HDT, Izod impact, MFI where available from literature.
result.summary: This question targets a specialized polymer compounding domain — N-phenylmaleimide (N-PMI) copolymer-based heat-resistant ABS for automotive interiors — requiring angles that span academic formulation science, additive supplier datasheets, automotive OEM standards, and recent flame-retardant/filler literature with quantitative property data.

angles.label: Broad / Primary formulation review
angles.query: N-phenylmaleimide ABS heat resistant compound HDT glass fiber mineral filler formulation automotive interior
angles.rationale: Casts a wide net for review papers and supplier white papers covering the core N-PMI/ABS system and common reinforcement additives with HDT and impact data.

angles.label: Academic / Quantitative property effects
angles.query: N-PMI SAN ABS terpolymer HDT Izod impact MFI flame retardant compatibilizer quantitative polymer journal
angles.rationale: Targets peer-reviewed literature (journals, conference proceedings) that report numerical property data — HDT, notched Izod, melt flow index — for specific additive loadings in N-PMI-containing blends.

angles.label: Flame retardant systems for heat-resistant ABS
angles.query: halogen-free flame retardant heat resistant ABS automotive interior low VOC HDT retention 100°C
angles.rationale: Isolates the flame retardant angle, focusing on halogen-free options (regulatory pressure) and their trade-off with HDT retention and VOC emissions — critical automotive interior requirements.

angles.label: Filler and reinforcement trade-offs
angles.query: glass fiber talc wollastonite ABS blend heat deflection temperature impact strength anisotropy automotive compound
angles.rationale: Covers inorganic filler strategies (glass fiber vs. platy minerals) and the known anisotropy/impact trade-off, surfacing formulator guidance and datasheet-level quantitative comparisons.

angles.label: Compatibilizer and impact modifier strategies
angles.query: maleic anhydride grafted rubber compatibilizer impact modifier ABS SAN blend morphology Izod notched automotive
angles.rationale: Focuses on reactive compatibilizers and core-shell or grafted rubber impact modifiers that maintain or recover Izod impact in stiff, heat-resistant ABS matrices, with morphology-property correlations.

angles.label: Practitioner / VOC and processability implementation
angles.query: automotive interior ABS VOC emission reduction processing additives flow improver heat stabilizer OEM specification
angles.rationale: Targets practitioner-level resources — OEM VOC specs (VDA 278, GM9305P), lubricant/stabilizer additive suppliers, and compounding guides — addressing processability and cabin air quality constraints.
